chunks: So he hurried to his family and brought a fatted calf,
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'brought a fatted calf' signify in the context of Quranic hospitality?
ai.summary: In Shia exegetical tradition, this verse (11:69) is often linked to the hospitality of the angels sent to Abraham, where the 'well-fed calf' signifies the immediate preparation of a meal for the honored guests. The act reflects the virtue of *karam* (generosity) and serves as a precursor to the revelation of good news regarding the birth of Isaac, emphasizing divine favor upon the patriarch.
